evals.prompt:
Generate a Persian resume from the following candidate data using the classic template and save as PDF:

- Name: علی احمدی
- Title: توسعه‌دهنده Full-Stack
- Email: ali@example.com | Phone: +98 912 123 4567
- Summary: 5 years web experience with Next.js 16, React 18, Django, FastAPI
- Experience: Snapp — Senior Backend Developer — ۱۴۰۱/۰۳ to now
  • Reduced API latency from 800ms to 120ms (85%)
  • Technologies: Python, Django, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker
- Education: University of Tehran — BSc Electrical — ۱۳۹۵–۱۳۹۹
- Skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js
- GitHub: github.com/ehsanghaffarii

Use the classic template (single-column layout). Save as PDF.
evals.expected_output:
A PDF file with:
- Classic single-column layout
- RTL document direction throughout
- Name, title, contact info in header
- Experience section with company/role/dates
- Skills with English terms intact (Next.js, React, not transliterated)
- Persian dates in Persian calendar
- URLs and emails readable and LTR
- Professional typography

evals.prompt:

  • Reduced response time ۳۰٪
  • Docker deployment
- Education: Sharif — CS Bachelor — ۱۳۹۸–۱۴۰۲
- GitHub: github.com/sarakarami

Focus on relevant experience for Backend role. Do not invent any information. Keep to one page.
evals.expected_output:
A PDF file with:
- Classic single-column layout
- Compact one-page layout
